page_title: ANG 2-4 PSG | Angers v PSG 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' 2 - 4 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 2:4.
90+7' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+7' Angers are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman makes the right call and Angers will have a corner.
90+6' None of the PSG players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
90+6' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) hits the right post with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
90+5' Marco Asensio (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is about to take a corner kick.
90+3' PSG are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Now PSG have a corner.
90+1' Substitution. Kang-In Lee did his best and is replaced by Joao Neves (PSG).

90+1' 1 - 4 It's a goal! Esteban Lepaul (Angers) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Himad Abdelli. The score is 1:4.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Angers quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' Substitution. Florent Hanin walks off the pitch and Jacques Ekomie (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
88' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' PSG are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
87' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
86' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
84' The free kick from long range, taken by Angers, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
83' Angers can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Angers are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee points to the corner flag and Angers will take a corner.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Marquinhos (PSG). Benoit Millot doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' A cross into the box picks out Kang-In Lee (PSG), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
79' Today's match ends for Ibrahima Niane who will be replaced by Bamba Dieng (Angers).
79' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Esteban Lepaul (Angers) replaces Farid El Melali.
78' Marquinhos (PSG) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
75' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Yahia Fofana. PSG win a corner.
74' Yoram Zague (PSG) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
74' Farid El Melali (Angers) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

72' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
70' Angers take a short corner kick.
70' Angers show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Angers win a corner kick.
69' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes a short corner kick.
69' Yoram Zague (PSG) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
68' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Jim Allevinah and he is replaced by Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
68' Jean-Eudes Aholou goes off the pitch and Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) comes on.
68' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
66' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Warren Zaire-Emery walks off.
66' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Senny Mayulu is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
65' A cross from a corner kick by Angers is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' Angers are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Angers will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
62' An attempted cross from Yoram Zague (PSG) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a magnificent save!
60' Angers will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
59' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benoit Millot ignores the protests.
59' Marco Asensio (PSG) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
57' Senny Mayulu (PSG) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The ball possession at the moment is 28:72.
53' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
50' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:7.

46' Half-time substitution. Achraf Hakimi will not participate anymore and Yoram Zague (PSG) is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 0 - 4 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Kang-In Lee is pounced on by Bradley Barcola (PSG). His close-range header flashes past Yahia Fofana and into the left of the goal. 0:4.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
42' Marco Asensio (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Yahia Fofana is alert and denies him with a nice save.

41' Farid El Melali (Angers) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
40' The referee blows his whistle as Bradley Barcola (PSG) was too aggressive in his challenge.
40' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

39' A nice pass finds Senny Mayulu (PSG) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Yahia Fofana pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.

36' Marco Asensio (PSG) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
35' Farid El Melali (Angers) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Haris Belkebla (Angers) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
33' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
31' 0 - 3 It's 0:3! Marco Asensio feeds Bradley Barcola (PSG) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top of the net.
30' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
29' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' Marco Asensio (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Yahia Fofana.

27' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

25' Farid El Melali (Angers) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
24' The foul by Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Millot.
24' Half-chance! Senny Mayulu (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana reacts well to snuff out the attack.

22' A dangerous towering header by Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
22' Farid El Melali (Angers) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

21' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Angers will take a corner kick.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! Kang-In Lee (PSG) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Marco Asensio, then sends the ball inside the right post. 0:2.
19' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' 0 - 1 Kang-In Lee (PSG) scores a goal! He latched on to a precise cross inside the box and beat the keeper with a shot to the middle of the goal.
15' PSG are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. It's a throw-in for PSG.

13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

12' A cross by Bradley Barcola (PSG) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
10' Angers showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

8' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
6' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Senny Mayulu (PSG) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' The ball rebounds to Kang-In Lee (PSG) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
